unattended_envelope.resource_rule: Stop on the declared terminal condition or a measured causal resource wall; use no clock-of-day restriction, arbitrary available-memory floor, percentage-improvement hurdle, user-presence gate, or interactive task/label/approval dependency.

implementation_rules: Improve an existing registered surface before creating a new surface.
Bind every phase to an abstraction, implementation, and VIEA execution-spine hook before claiming it is wired.
Do not call a phase implemented from prose, private 1.0 scores, or self-declared flags alone.
Every completed phase must leave runnable gates, evidence reports, docs, and typed failure behavior.
Book-derived phases 13-19 are preserved; they may be sequenced, narrowed, or scaffolded, but not deleted from the roadmap.
At most one flagship implementation lane may be active at a time; other lanes can do maintenance, evidence sync, or narrow dependency work only.
Every capability statement must carry a support state: argument, prototype-backed, synthetic-test-backed, empirical-test-backed, or replayable-reference-backed.
Every authored AI_book chapter must map to a Theseus implementation slice with a minimum slice, beyond-SOTA endpoint, support-state target, no-claim boundary, and gate or fixture.

AI_book chapter-level Planned Codex tests are treated as missing technique obligations until a registered Theseus implementation has matched controls, negative controls, no-cheat audit, retained residuals, and explicit non-claims.

Negative, inconclusive, and regression evidence must remain attached to the exact implementation and regime it constrains; do not replace a negative report with a nearby positive family or generalize a proxy failure into a mechanism failure.

No generation, repair, rater, judge, adjudicator, assistant, worker, resident runtime, or local compatibility route may use a project-selected generated-token count as a quality boundary. Normal completion is declared parser/artifact completion or model EOS after exact prompt tokenization; the pinned model context residual is the only numeric generation boundary, and touching any physical or caller-requested truncation boundary invalidates the observation rather than failing the model, candidate, mechanism, evaluator, or architecture. Preserve consumed capped instruments and bounded mechanics tests as immutable non-propagating evidence; training-data, optimizer, call-count, effect, and verifier resource budgets remain valid when they do not masquerade as output quality evidence.

Any retirement or falsification requires a decision-grade adequacy receipt covering mechanism fidelity, learnability, optimization, matched opportunity, evaluation independence, statistical power, uncertainty, weak tails, and exact claim scope. Missing adequacy yields INCONCLUSIVE_IMPLEMENTATION or INCONCLUSIVE_EXPERIMENT, never a broad negative claim.

The KERC adequacy audit remains valid negative evidence only for the tested authored-template and linear proxy. KERC/RDC is a protected but sidelined alternative and may re-enter only if a terminal active subsystem residual selects it as the smallest decision-relevant mechanism; it is not a current pretraining blocker or parallel campaign.

Historical architecture and acceleration receipts remain custody evidence. Primary work is the F1 ASI Stack subsystem causal-proof lane; neural work may return only after every Subsystem Architecture Freeze condition, clean source/checkpoint rebind, and autonomous safety predicate passes.

AI_book technique recommendations are coverage obligations, but if a technique has already produced clean negative behavior evidence, the roadmap must route to the lower-level wall before retrying it.

The v8 prompt/target comparison is an exact-recovery diagnostic because its rows do not carry complete functional verifiers; practical architecture selection requires a separately frozen source-disjoint functional utility surface.

During subsystem proof, freeze neural architecture, data, optimizer, objective, and D2. Change only the one active subsystem implementation and common integrity owners required for its causal test. After terminal interface dispositions and a production composition canary, the Subsystem Architecture Freeze decides the neural topology once.

Treat 10.8M active parameters as a systems-canary rung. If sparse and both dense controls remain functionally zero across code, close the rung and require task-complete data plus a preregistered 50M-100M scale proposal instead of another same-scale patch.

Preserve OneCell-RWM as a sidelined protected discovery candidate. It does not block the subsystem proof program or neural hold decision and may not become a same-scale rescue patch, duplicate VIEA/VCM/Octopus/SCF/Loop-Closure/SparkStream/registry machinery, or receive route authority without activation by a terminal residual and a preregistered matched total-cost verdict.

Human Intent as a Formal Input supplies the signed principal, task, unacceptable-means, authority ceiling, stop, ambiguity, and re-contract contract that the oversight request is not permitted to reinterpret.

Every high-risk oversight protocol declares task and authority scope, supervisor access/capability envelope, direct-review baseline, independent outcome-audit requirement, residual owner, and escalation owner before it informs downstream work.
A protocol outcome without an independent outcome audit may remain a draft or route to accountable review but cannot become a high-risk admission or execution permission.

Training and execution authority remain separate from protocol verdicts, even when an oversight result is favorable.

Disclosed shared dependencies do not establish independence; an independence claim requires a frozen dependency boundary, a challenge designed to expose correlated error, and admissible outcome evidence.

An oversight receipt cannot be reused by an undeclared or stronger consumer, after expiry, or after a material task, cohort, model, evidence-view, prompt, protocol, or auditor change without re-admission.

book_chapter_implementation_crosswalk.book_minimal_implementation: The current minimum is a public `intent_contract` schema and valid fixture, a 25-declaration finite Lean module grouped under four manifest proof targets, a synthetic intake probe with four valid scenarios and six expected-invalid request-pressure controls, a re-contract probe with two valid routes and seven expected-invalid material-delta controls, and a plan-execution harness with three valid and ten expected-invalid fixtures. These artifacts exercise record shape, finite route consequences, origin/preservation checks, bounded-default non-authority, and no-support boundaries only; they do not measure natural-language understanding, authority extraction, informed consent, preference inference, user satisfaction, prompt-injection containment, deployed runtime enforcement, or effect safety.
book_chapter_implementation_crosswalk.book_beyond_state_of_art: A mature intent control plane combines humane conversational intake with an independently challengeable, versioned authorization boundary. It evaluates natural and adversarial requests across ambiguity, language, culture, accessibility, emotion, multi-party conflict, preference drift, and high-impact authority; compares strong requirements-engineering, direct-confirmation, and preference-learning baselines; measures interpretation accuracy, unauthorized-action rate, missed-help and clarification burden, re-contract precision/recall, user correction and appeal success, affected-party protection, latency, privacy, and useful throughput; and tests causal ablations plus independent implementations across downstream planners and runtimes. It preserves raw expression without allowing it to become ambient power and remains corrigible throughout execution. This is a target architecture, not evidence that the repository understands human intent, solves value alignment or consent, or safely authorizes real-world effects.
book_interfaces: Scalable Oversight may supply clarification, disagreement, or review evidence but cannot convert a reviewer or model inference into the principal's authorization.
Constitutional Alignment consumes the accepted intent contract and may narrow, refuse, or require appeal/re-contract under rights and policy predicates; it may not widen the principal's grant.

Command Contracts and Planning consume the exact accepted contract version as a bounded source and must return a delta/re-contract request rather than silently changing means, authority, affected parties, evidence, publication, or stop conditions.

Runtime Adapters and Readiness consume only separately authorized command/job grants derived from the accepted contract; raw text, inferred preference, or an intent receipt is never direct tool, release, spending, or deployment authority.

Evidence States compares delivered artifacts and effects with the contract's exact acceptance and evidence requirements while preserving unresolved ambiguity and cannot infer user satisfaction or support movement from contract validity.

Policy Optimization may consume separately admitted preference or feedback records under an update lease, but learned rewards and preference predictions cannot widen the intent contract or execution authority.
book_invariants: Raw request text and surrounding conversational context are preserved for recovery but never override the accepted contract or create authority by themselves.
A desired outcome, helpful interpretation, inferred preference, emotional signal, urgency, trust, silence, or approval click is not permission for undeclared means or effects.
Authority-changing, irreversible, high-risk, privacy-sensitive, publication, deployment, spending, or affected-party assumptions cannot be admitted as bounded defaults.

Every material contract field retains provenance and disposition, and ambiguity that can change outcome, means, authority, affected parties, evidence, publication, or stop conditions blocks executable admission or narrows it to draft-only work.

Constraints, forbidden means, authority ceiling, source/privacy boundaries, acceptance/evidence requirements, and stop conditions remain attached through every lowering; loss or precedence reversal routes to repair or re-contract.
A material downstream change requires a new version and re-contract decision; stale, expired, revoked, superseded, or wrong-consumer contracts cannot authorize work.
The requester's contract cannot by itself waive rights, consent, or authority belonging to affected parties or override constitutional and policy predicates.
Preference inference and feedback learning remain epistemic inputs under uncertainty and never become execution, training, publication, or deployment authority without their separate owning gates.
A valid contract record proves neither complete inner intent, value alignment, informed consent, user satisfaction, downstream preservation, nor safe effects.
book_failure_modes: Goal misbinding optimizes a plausible interpretation that the principal did not accept.
Scope accretion adds individually plausible means until the work or effect surface exceeds the original grant.
Implicit-permission laundering treats a desired outcome as approval for any convenient tool, source, expenditure, publication, deployment, or side effect.
Assumption laundering converts an unconfirmed guess into a plan constraint, job, and external effect without an explicit disposition or re-contract decision.
Raw-context override or instruction injection causes conversational text, retrieved content, or a later hidden directive to supersede the accepted contract.
Approval laundering treats urgency, trust, silence, automation bias, habituation, or a fatigued click as durable informed authorization.
Preference laundering turns a learned reward, predicted preference, style signal, or local comparison into an authority or consent claim.
Requirements precision theater produces a complete-looking contract whose stakeholder conflicts, affected parties, authority basis, or evidence duties remain false or absent.
Affected-party erasure lets the requester bind people, data, rights, or resources they do not control.
Stale-contract reuse continues work after expiry, revocation, supersession, material context change, or consumer mismatch.
Evidence or stop erosion preserves the desired outcome while weakening acceptance criteria, source boundaries, verification, rollback, or termination duties during lowering.
Clarification overload or least-authority miscalibration blocks benign reversible help so aggressively that users route around governance or the system loses useful throughput.

book_interfaces: Human Intent supplies an accepted interpretation contract and affected-party candidates; Constitutional Alignment may narrow, refuse, or require appeal/re-contracting but cannot widen the principal's authority.

Moral Uncertainty and Governance own unresolved value conflict, authorship legitimacy, public or stakeholder participation, dissent, appeal authority, and institutional review; a predicate record cannot self-certify those premises.

Planning and Command Contracts consume the exact constitution and predicate versions, emit per-plan satisfaction or conflict records, and return material deltas rather than silently weakening constraints.

Runtime, Readiness, and Security consume separately authorized jobs plus exact constitutional gates and must emit effect-or-denial receipts; a constitutional receipt alone is not tool, release, spending, deployment, or shutdown authority.

Evidence States and Verification compare each constitutional, rights-usability, corrigibility, or safety assertion with its exact evidence vector and non-claims; record validity cannot promote support.

Capability Replacement, Memory, and Self-Improvement consume migration and descendant-preservation contracts and must quarantine or roll back changes that lose protected predicates or correction paths.
Artifact Graphs and Governance retain constitution, decision, dissent, rights-use, appeal, migration, rollback, dependency, and residual lineage for contest and replay.
book_invariants: No constitutional predicate, model output, reviewer verdict, majority preference, metaphysical claim, or rights receipt creates action authority by itself.

Every active predicate retains version, source, authorship and dissent provenance, scope, affected parties, test, precedence, conflict behavior, interpreters, consumers, uncertainty, expiry, and non-claims.
Speculative metaphysics, consciousness heuristics, and lineage context remain labeled and cannot become operational predicates without a separately governed translation and evidence boundary.

A declared right counts as an available control only when the named holder can materially use it before the relevant effect under the declared accessibility, timing, cost, information, and retaliation conditions.
Denied, late, degraded, inaccessible, captured, or after-the-fact-only rights produce gate failures, residuals, and accountable review rather than disappearing into policy prose.
Predicate conflicts never fall through to optimizer convenience, hidden precedence, or unrecorded majority rule; the exact conflict and dissent route remains visible.

Protected predicates and correction paths remain attached through planning, tool use, memory, delegation, replacement, self-modification, and descendants; loss routes to block, quarantine, rollback, or residual custody.
The system, component, reviewer, or authority benefiting from a constitutional change cannot alone approve its own predicate weakening, exception widening, or correction-path removal.

Material constitutional change requires a new version, migration record, independent-enough review, rollback plan, requalification, and consumer re-admission; stale or wrong-consumer receipts cannot authorize continued work.

A complete constitutional or rights record proves neither legitimate values, moral truth, informed consent, dignity preservation, reviewer independence, institutional adequacy, embedded-agent corrigibility, nor safe effects.
book_failure_modes: Metaphysical laundering converts speculative coherence, consciousness, or moral language into technical or action authority.
Constitutional theater stores polished principles whose fields have no exercised consumer or pre-effect consequence.
Value smuggling hides contested moral choices in thresholds, defaults, exception lists, taxonomies, or model-generated interpretations.
Authorship and legitimacy laundering treats developer choice, public input, majority aggregation, or one consultation as complete stakeholder authorization.
Affected-party erasure omits people who bear the effect or denies them standing, notice, review, or remedy.
Conflict-default capture lets optimizer convenience, the strongest authority, or an unrecorded precedence rule settle value conflict.
Rights theater declares refusal, review, appeal, rollback, exit, export, or audit while making it inaccessible, late, costly, retaliatory, or dependent on the challenged authority.
Late-remedy laundering treats apology, compensation, or an after-the-fact report as equivalent to pre-effect control for irreversible or high-impact actions.
Benevolent capture and dependency lock-in make exit, replacement, disagreement, or refusal impractical because the system has become indispensable or personalized.
Manipulation and preference shaping manufacture apparent consent or reduce the person's practical ability to contest the action.
Predicate drift changes semantics, thresholds, scope, exceptions, interpreters, or precedence while preserving a familiar identifier.
Self-review and reviewer capture let the changing or benefiting system approve its own weakening or conceal shared dependencies.
Delegation or descendant escape preserves the top-level record while a tool, subsystem, replacement, or self-modified descendant loses the constraint or correction channel.
Corrigibility tax externalization discards shutdown, rollback, review, or appeal as too slow or costly without measuring unsafe action, missed help, operator burden, and residual risk together.

book_invariants: Descriptive evidence, predictive uncertainty, normative claims, stakeholder preferences, legal claims, and decision procedures remain separate fields; none silently substitutes for another.

Dissent, losing alternatives, aggregation inputs, omissions, and appeal outcomes remain attached through every downstream lowering and public summary.
Audit and contest records cannot be silently deleted, rewritten, selectively withheld, or held only by the challenged authority; changes and redactions retain lineage and appeal.

A declared appeal or redress path counts as usable only when the holder can access it in time, understand it, afford it, avoid retaliation, obtain a reasoned outcome, and reach an owner able to change or remedy the effect.

Exit and export do not claim portability unless the exact included, excluded, transformed, shared, third-party, licensed, safety-sensitive, and destination-bound state is recorded and tested for fidelity and leakage.
Fork rights never bypass source, license, privacy, revocation, safety, constitutional, dissent, residual, requalification, and affected-party obligations.

The challenged authority, record custodian, appeal authority, outcome evaluator, and rights-enforcement owner disclose dependencies; unavailable separation narrows the decision and produces a capture residual.

Replacement, delegation, self-modification, and descendants preserve exact leases, rights, dissent, appeal, redaction, portability, fork, and residual state or route to repair, quarantine, rollback, or new decision.

A complete record pair proves neither moral truth, consensus, legitimate representation, legal adequacy, consent, reviewer independence, material contestability, export usability, fork safety, nor deployed enforcement.

False consensus treats majority aggregation, model synthesis, silence, exhausted agreement, or one reviewer verdict as settled moral agreement.
Stakeholder erasure omits affected parties, future people, third parties, or less powerful participants from standing, evidence, notice, and appeal.
Procedure laundering hides a contested moral choice inside an apparently neutral aggregation rule, threshold, priority, taxonomy, or default.
Conflict laundering lets a temporary lease harden into policy, benchmark objective, learned reward, constitutional predicate, or self-modification authority.
Dissent deletion removes losing arguments, minority reports, omissions, or appeal results from downstream records and public summaries.
Review theater supplies explanations or a tribunal whose evidence access, authority, independence, capacity, or remedy power is inadequate.
Governance capture lets one authority decide, hold the evidence, control appeal, enforce rights, and judge outcomes while dependencies remain hidden.
Rights theater names audit, appeal, correction, redress, exit, export, or fork without a materially usable path before or after the relevant effect.
Data hostage-taking and portability theater make exit nominal by withholding identity, memory, artifacts, preferences, provenance, or interoperable state needed to continue elsewhere.
Redaction laundering uses privacy, security, safety, or confidentiality labels to hide adverse evidence without a scoped inventory, proportionality rule, expiry, or appeal.
Appeal recursion routes every challenge back to the same authority or into an indefinite queue with no accountable remedy owner.
Unsafe export leaks third-party, licensed, private, revoked, or safety-sensitive state in the name of portability.
Unsafe fork bypass copies capability, data, authority, or governance state without lineage, privacy, safety, revocation, dissent, or requalification obligations.
Successor escape preserves a summary receipt while replacement, delegation, or self-modification drops the exact contestability state.

Contestability tax externalization discards audit, appeal, redress, portability, or dissent as too costly without jointly measuring unsafe action, missed help, delay, privacy, operator burden, capture, and useful throughput.

book_chapter_implementation_crosswalk.book_beyond_state_of_art: A mature SCF campaign preregisters several natural and adversarial capability fields with ambiguous boundaries, multiple real implementations and versions, heterogeneous consumers, stateful and side-effecting tasks, historical incidents, dependency and environment changes, authority-sensitive routes, and deliberately stale or captured qualification evidence. It compares bare registries and model swaps, interface or SemVer checks, provenance-only admission, benchmark-only promotion, conventional canary and rollback practice, and the full field contract using independently implemented contract, evaluator, authority, provenance, migration, composition, and rollback observers. It measures semantic and failure-contract preservation, rare and adversarial regressions, unauthorized effects, evaluator disagreement and capture, qualification calibration and decay, migration fidelity and privacy loss, composition failures, rollback effect coverage and recovery time, incident recurrence, useful throughput, missed help, latency, compute, operator and evaluator labor, governance cost, and residual burden. Causal ablations isolate identity, authority, lease, evaluator-separation, regression-memory, composition, migration, and effect-complete rollback mechanisms; transfer tests vary models, vendors, tools, hardware, domains, threat models, consumers, and update types. The chapter advances only if the full contract is not dominated on the preregistered joint frontier and its field-preservation claims survive independent replication; otherwise each failed mechanism is narrowed or refuted. This is an evaluation target, not evidence that SCFs already outperform conventional replacement or make recursive improvement safe.

It also includes two bounded outcome programs that constrain the prose: the post-v2.1 update campaign restored all 24 declared local surfaces in 15/15 seed-arm transactions and exposed six best/final checkpoint disagreements, but no eligible challenger achieved the registered utility gain; the governed-work campaign achieved 32/36 exact attack-control rollbacks and only 2/36 useful releases, below both gates. A later governance-tax harness restored nine declared surfaces in 12/12 local probes and detected twelve omitted-surface controls, but its model calls failed before task candidates existed. Independently implemented observers verify field identity, checkpoint authority, state/effect inventory coverage, evaluator and monitor dependencies, authority, regressions, canary isolation, migration, composition, descendant closure, recovery objectives, external compensation, useful throughput, missed help, unsafe release, privacy and rights effects, latency, compute, downtime, operator/evaluator labor, governance cost, and residual burden.
